'''''Cycas sexseminifera''''' is a species of [[cycad]] in [[northern Vietnam]] and [[southern China]].

==Range==
It is widespread in:<ref>{{cite iucn |author=Hill, K.D |year=2010 |title=''Cycas sexseminifera'' |volume=2010 |article-number=e.T42084A10624720 |doi=10.2305/IUCN.UK.2010-3.RLTS.T42084A10624720.en |access-date=12 January 2020}}</ref>
*southern and central [[Guangxi]], [[China]]
*[[Cao Bang Province]], [[Vietnam]]
*[[Thanh Hoa Province]], [[Vietnam]]
